name: context-gauge
description: The context's fill against Claude Code's auto-compact limit on the status line, and a short note to Claude when it passes 50, 75 and 90%

bands.title: Bands (%)
bands.description: Claude is told once when the context passes each of these percentages of the auto-compact limit, until the next compaction. Whole numbers from 1 to 99, separated by commas. off: the status line only.
